_about: Seed configuration, loaded into the database once (an empty service_standards / holidays table). After that, admins manage rules and holidays on the Service standards page. Every seeded rule is UNVERIFIED: the values come from RoadSense's research notes, not from a checked official publication, so the dashboard reports 'unable to determine' for them until an administrator verifies the source or approves the rule.

rules.notes: Research notes: HRM repairs take 7 to 30 business days depending on priority; staff typically connect within 10 business days of a 311 call. Default for anything not covered by a more specific rule.
Research notes: priority potholes, 7 business days. Which RoadSense severity bands HRM treats as priority is an assumption to confirm with HRM.
Research notes: 7 to 120 days on provincial roads. The unit (business or calendar days) and the official source are not verified.
Research notes: urgent provincial potholes, 7 days. Unit, priority mapping and official source are not verified.

holidays._about: Illustrative Nova Scotia holiday calendar (observed dates). Confirm each authority's own calendar; add authority-specific days on the Service standards page.
